svg.title: Lockstep — Linux service benchmark
svg.desc: A recorded Nginx benchmark comparing all protections, selected protections, and unprotected execution. The table shows requests per second, median response time, and the throughput cost relative to unprotected execution with the same library. Charts show memory increase and processor use during the recorded window. This is not a new benchmark or a security verification.
svg.text: File Edit View Insert Format Help
Blocks heap attacks using memory checks and protected function calls.
Recorded Nginx performance. Protection is layered; coverage depends on the attack and configuration.
Response time is the median. Each protection setting is compared with its own unprotected library.
Source: benchmark_results.json | Recorded window: ~4s per setting | Processor use can exceed 100% across cores.
